extDescription.message: Open, edit, organize, sign and save PDFs in Chrome with PdfCraft. Works offline; your files stay on your computer.

viewerOpenLocalTip.message: Open a PDF from your computer

viewerOpenNativeOriginal.message: Open original in Chrome's PDF viewer

viewerFramedTitle.message: Open this document in its own tab

viewerFramedDetail.message: PdfCraft doesn't run inside other web pages.

viewerNotPdfDetail.message: The server sent a file that isn't a PDF (labelled $1). The link may need you to sign in on the website first, or it may not point at a PDF.

viewerDeniedDetail.message: The server refused access (HTTP $1). Sign in on the website, then try again.

viewerMissingDetail.message: The document isn't there any more (HTTP $1).

viewerHttpDetail.message: The server answered with an error (HTTP $1).

viewerOfflineDetail.message: Connect to the internet to download this document. PdfCraft itself works offline: you can still open a PDF from your computer.

viewerFileDetail.message: Turn on "Allow access to file URLs" for PdfCraft on chrome://extensions, or open the file with the button below.

viewerStartFailedDetail.message: $1. PdfCraft needs WebGL 2: check that hardware acceleration is on in Chrome's settings (System).

optWebPdfs.message: Open PDFs from the web in PdfCraft

optWebPdfsHint.message: When off, Chrome's own viewer shows them. You can still open any PDF from the toolbar button or a link's right-click menu.

optOctetHint.message: Some servers send PDFs as generic downloads (application/octet-stream). Open those in PdfCraft when the address ends in .pdf.

optLocal.message: Open PDFs from your computer in PdfCraft

optLocalHint.message: For file:// addresses, such as PDFs dragged into Chrome.

optFileAccessOff.message: Chrome doesn't let PdfCraft read local files yet. Turn on "Allow access to file URLs" on PdfCraft's details page.

optEmbedded.message: Show "Open in PdfCraft" on embedded PDFs

optEmbeddedHint.message: A button on PDFs shown inside web pages.

optAboutPrivacy.message: PdfCraft runs entirely inside Chrome. Documents are processed on your computer and never uploaded; there is no account and no server.

optAboutPermissions.message: Access to all sites lets PdfCraft redirect PDF links to its viewer and download the PDF for you, with your cookies for sites you are signed in to. It reads nothing else.

optAboutLicence.message: PdfCraft is free software under the MIT or Apache-2.0 licence.

embeddedOpenTip.message: Open this PDF in a PdfCraft tab to edit, sign or save it

viewerDropHint.message: Drop PDFs to open them in PdfCraft

landing_signTitle.message: Choose a PDF to fill and sign

landingDetail.message: Select a file or drop it here. It stays on your computer.

popupConvertHint.message: Export to Word, images and more

popupInPdfCraft.message: This PDF is open in PdfCraft

popupInPdfCraftDetail.message: $1 · Convert, Edit and E-Sign below use this document.
